The search features within ValveConnect brings commonality to the valve market for the first time, and now buyers can search for exactly the valve they need by size and specification directly from their desktop or mobile device at any time and from anywhere.

For the companies who subscribe and list their inventory ValveConnect can also be much more. Not only does it provide a sales outlet to the whole world but it also can be a very effective inventory management tool between businesses. They can now link their inventory to any partner company they choose i.e. create their own private intranet should they wish meaning that they can share and move stock even if there is no shared SAP/MRP system between them. The potential for sharing stock with key customers or sister companies is enormous, and all at a tiny fraction of the cost that any IT project would cost.

- The entire purchasing process is managed from the user’s mobile device or tablet
- Eliminates hand-written orders, voicemails and texts
- A single order interface generates orders to multiple suppliers, saving hours of time vs. placing separate orders with each supplier
- Automates invoicing & payment of invoices
- Integrated with daily POS information and receipt of orders directly into popular accounting packages like QuickBooks
